# @cortex-ui/card-host-card

The card host (card.host) at the right of the brand band: a toggle with a live summary, Open pane while the right pane is collapsed, and the card it opens; hosts card.header@1, the card.*@1 sections and settings.host@1.

- **Plugin id:** `card-host.card`
- **Slot:** `workbench.band@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `workbench.band@1` as `card-host.card`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** `card.header@1`, `settings.host@1`; every `card.<name>@1` plugin, as a card section; `settings.host@1` when settings open
- **Workbench state read:** `card.open`, `code.target`, `layout.paneCollapsed`, `overlay.open`, `projectId`, `sessionId`, `settings.open`
- **Workbench state written:** `card.open`, `layout.paneCollapsed`, `overlay.open`, `settings.open`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** none
- **Frame methods called:** `agents.list`, `frame.session.list`, `memory.task.list`, `model.slots`, `vcs.status`
- **Topics followed:** `agents.changed`, `memory.task.changed`, `session.changed`, `tools.files_changed`, `vcs.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
